.critical-issues-section { background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .critical-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #991b1b; margin: 0 0 1rem 0; } .warning-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; color: #dc2626; } .issues-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .issue-item { background: white; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; border-left: 4px solid #ef4444; color: #1f2937; } .issue-file { font-weight: 600; color: #991b1b; } .issue-count { color: #dc2626; }
